description: Request a new parametric product category or a missing filter property on an existing category so it can be scraped and normalized into the catalog.

kind.description: "category" to request a new product category, or "property" to request a filter field on an existing category.

notes.description: Example ASINs, search terms, or engineering use case.

properties.description: Desired filterable parameters / schema fields (e.g. "cutout_mm, contact_form, led_voltage_v, ip_rating").

target_category.description: Existing category id if kind="property", or proposed slug if kind="category".

title.description: Name of the requested category or property (e.g. "Anti-vandal pushbutton switches" or "mounting_hole_diameter_mm").

name: suggest_catalog_addition
